about_the_game:
《CyberMaid》— Your Personal Maid, Always by Your Side!

✨ The Cutest Desktop Maid to Brighten Up Your PC! ✨

Want to make your desktop more fun and lively? CyberMaid is a charming interactive desktop application. Your personal maid will always keep an eye on your mouse movements, providing a sense of companionship and making your work and gaming moments more relaxing!

🌹 Main Features:

💖 Adorable Eye-Tracking: Her eyes will follow your mouse movements, making you feel her attention!

💬 Easy and Fun Interactions: Click on specific parts of her to trigger cute reactions and discover more surprises!

🔥 Perfect for These Users:

✔ Fans of anime characters and maid culture

✔ Students, office workers, and streamers who want desktop companionship

✔ Gamers who love customizing their desktop with aesthetics and fun

💠💠💠💠💠💠💠💠💠

🎮 Controls 🎮

🖱 Left Mouse Button: Drag the maid

🖱 Double Left Click: Open settings menu

🖱 Right Mouse Button: Interact with the maid to trigger cute reactions

🎡 Mouse Wheel: Adjust the maid's distance

🌀 Hold and drag the Middle Mouse Button: Switch to 360-degree free view (see her from any angle you like!)

💡 About Updates and Game Growth 💡

CyberMaid is a project that will gradually grow over time.
We will continue to bring detailed optimizations and new features to make her increasingly close to your life and imagination.

All players who have purchased the game will receive these updates for free.
We hope this is not just a game, but a small daily companion that can accompany you for a while.

In the future, if there are large-scale content expansions, the price may be adjusted.
This will be to make the work more complete and more worthy of long-term collection.

Whether you've just met her or say good morning to her every day,
we cherish this companionship and will strive to make her better and better.

Thank you for placing her on your desktop and making her a small part of your life.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent suggestive content, including interactive physics-based body reactions. Players can interact with fully clothed female characters using the mouse or controller, and the physics system allows natural responses such as movement in reaction to applied force and jiggle effects.

While the game includes frequent suggestive interactions, it does not feature nudity, sexual acts, or explicit depictions of intercourse.The game does not depict non-consensual actions, violence, or any sensitive material.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Six-core Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
